scope: one-process HC-up original BF16 prefill fused SiLU/S4 pack screen, not independent confirmation

build.rule: Prefill HC-up95 only; same corrected-GDN production objects, original BF16 retained for decode. Existing direct-BF16 v002 positive radix16 files checked bytewise against original resident BF16 GPU repack. Fused SiLU/BF16-round/S4x2 residual pack then four DPAS. Skip blk44-attn and BF16X2. First-use initialization and 315.5MiB persistent extra VRAM must be measured, never hidden from cold TTFT. Full-output+guards+CPU quantized oracle before model runs. No production change or speed acceptance.

model.rule: Same new binary A1/B1/A2; original decode objects and BF16 weights retained; candidate prefill HC-up95 only. cache5500/slots5771 fixed; Original prefill8192/short-read1024 with Short16 primer, then original2K/full128. Large prompts exceed the short-read threshold. First candidate request includes lazy loading/BF16 binding/repack overhead. Baseline must match corrected-GDN full outputs and no all-zero output may pass. U4 candidate outputs may differ, but require full count and finite-state/quality screen before performance acceptance. One diagnostic request/case/process only; no speed acceptance. Preserve baseline corruption, still exercise the candidate dispatch and repeat A2 to delimit the problem. Candidate cold request includes all repack validation. All model timing is descriptive; independent quality and performance gates remain required. No production change.
